## Note
Current builds are SSR-safe.

## Old workaround
If you previously excluded packages from SSR, you can remove that config in most cases.

title: React Native — Metro + SVG troubleshooting (older)
content_markdown:
## Troubleshooting
If icons don’t render, confirm `react-native-svg` is installed and you’re not importing web-only builds.

## Tip
Clear Metro cache after adding SVG deps.

title: Flutter — Asset pipeline & theming notes (archived)
content_markdown:
## Archived
The recommended path is still `flutter_svg`.

## Theming
Use a `ColorFilter` for tinting monochrome icons; keep original SVGs unmodified.

title: React — TypeScript tips for icon props
content_markdown:
## TypeScript
Icon components accept standard SVG props.

## Tip
Pass `aria-label` for accessible-only icons and set `focusable={false}` when needed.

title: Vue — Performance: on-demand imports
content_markdown:
## Performance
Prefer named imports to keep bundles small.

## Tip
Avoid registering the entire icon set globally; import only what you render.

title: Angular — A11y and title attributes
content_markdown:
## Accessibility
Set `aria-label` for interactive icons.

## Tip
If an icon is decorative, add `aria-hidden="true"` to keep screen readers clean.

title: Svelte — A11y patterns for icon-only buttons
content_markdown:
## Accessibility
Icon-only buttons should include a visually-hidden label.

## Tip
Use `aria-label` or an sr-only span to describe action.

title: React Native — Accessibility & hitSlop notes
content_markdown:
## Accessibility
Use `accessibilityLabel` for icon buttons.

## Tip
Add `hitSlop` for small tap targets when using 16–20px icons.

title: Flutter — Widget sizing and baseline alignment
content_markdown:
## Layout
Wrap `SvgPicture` in `SizedBox` for consistent sizing.

## Tip
For text alignment, use `Baseline` or adjust padding to match font metrics.
